title: Procedural Music Generator
description: A Python synthesizer that generates drum patterns (kick, snare, hi-hat) and a bass-and-lead melodic line entirely from math, then writes them as a stereo 44.1kHz WAV file. Uses numpy for all signal generation: kick drums via frequency-modulated sine waves with exponential decay, snares from layered noise plus tonal body, hi-hats from differentiated noise bursts, bass from soft-clipped sine waves, and leads with vibrato. The composition uses a C minor pentatonic scale with a I-V-I-IV progression across 4 bars at 120 BPM.
